description.en: The application ID. Create and find this ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The ID of an existing channel. Only a single ID is supported.
The settings for blacklists and whitelists.

description.zh: 单元格设置，做多设置16个。
description.en: The cell settings. You can set a maximum of 16 cells.

description.zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字节。
description.en: The task ID. Only a single ID is supported. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 55 bytes.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for each user is 10. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. Throttling can affect your business. Call this API at a reasonable rate.
